vSpeeds.source: Beechcraft King Air 350 POH — Vmo 263 KIAS (SL-21,000ft, decreasing above); Vfe approach-flap stage 202 KIAS. Addon's acf_Vno (182kt) is actually Va (maneuvering speed), not a cruise ceiling — overridden here.
Cessna 172SP POH — Vno 129 KIAS, Vne 163 KIAS, Vso 40 KIAS. Vfe uses the less-restrictive 0-10° flap stage (110 KIAS); full-flap (30°) Vfe is lower at 85 KIAS — staged flap limits aren't modeled.

Beechcraft Baron 58 POH — Vno 195 KIAS, Vne 223 KIAS, Vso 73 KIAS. Vfe uses the less-restrictive 15° flap stage (152 KIAS); full-flap (30°) Vfe is lower at 122 KIAS — staged flap limits aren't modeled.

Cessna Citation X POH — Vmo 270 KIAS (SL-8,000ft; rises to 350 KIAS then Mmo .935 above); Vfe (full flap) 180 KIAS; Vso 115 KIAS. Low-altitude Vmo used as the flat ceiling — the altitude-varying schedule above 8,000ft isn't modeled.
Cirrus SR22 POH — Vno 176 KIAS, Vne 205 KIAS, Vso 59 KIAS. Vfe uses the less-restrictive 50% flap stage (150 KIAS); full-flap (100%) Vfe is lower at 110 KIAS — staged flap limits aren't modeled.
Cirrus Vision SF50 AFM — Vmo 250 KIAS (Mmo .53); Vfe uses the less-restrictive 50%/takeoff/approach flap stage (190 KIAS); full-flap (100%/land) Vfe is lower at 150 KIAS. Vso 67 KIAS.

Lancair Evolution (PT6A turbine) — Vmo 240 KIAS, Vne 250 KIAS, Vso 65 KIAS. Vfe uses the less-restrictive takeoff-flap stage (140 KIAS); full-flap Vfe is lower at 125 KIAS — staged flap limits aren't modeled. Lower-confidence source (kitplane QRG, not a certified POH).
